name: lokkju
description: lokkju's Claude Code plugins and agent skills.

plugins.name: session-decisions
plugins.description: An in-session queue of the decisions and actions an assistant is waiting on you for, in the task list, shown as cards in the transcript and a sidebar.

plugins.name: forge-release
plugins.description: Release-PR setup across forges; for now, a helper that creates a GitHub App for release tokens and stores its credentials.

plugins.name: forge-tracker
plugins.description: Keeps work on the forge's issue tracker and the tracker honest enough to plan from; for now on GitHub: /catchup (what changed and what's waiting on you), /next (what to work on) and /groom (tracker drift, fixed only on your approval).

plugins.name: term-recorder
plugins.description: Drives a terminal program from a step file on a private tmux server and captures what it shows: text snaps, an asciicast and a GIF. For checking how a TUI really renders, and for demos.

plugins.name: claude-session-index
plugins.description: Index, search, and report on Claude Code sessions. TPS skill for work summarization.
